description: This file defines the class CheckUnrestrictedPermissionsVisitor, which extends CheckPermissionsVisitor, and is used to visit resource nodes in a permission enforcement context, specifically to check for unrestricted permissions within a resource hierarchy.

classes.name: CheckUnrestrictedPermissionsVisitor
